Orphic pass. 11 -> 20 records. Utnapishtim/Atra-hasis/Ziusudra/Xisouthros recorded as ONE figure with three aliases, not four records. Erra NOT added: already an alias on mesopotamian_nergal. Ninurta and Ningirsu kept as two records with equated-with in both directions, as were their wives Gula and Bau. Nanaya added and linked counterpart-of to the pre-existing sogdian_nana, which descends from her. 9 REJECT are all classes rather than figures (Anunnaki, Igigi, Apkallu, Lamassu, Udug, Gallu, Sebitti) plus Kur and the mace Sharur. 2 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL, not DONE: 5 BLOCKED rows (the Lagash divine family and the Der pantheon) plus the Ur III minor city gods, the Assyrian royal line and the king-list dynasties remain. See audits/lane-3/mesopotamian-census.tsv and mesopotamian-audit.md.

First Egyptian pass. 76 -> 150 records. Of the 76 baseline records roughly 40 were pharaohs, queens and royal children, so the pantheon itself held about 36. An 87-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 7 hits and 80 absences, including Apep (the registry held Ra, Maat and the entire solar apparatus and not the serpent it exists to resist), six of the eight members of the Ogdoad, all four sons of Horus, all three bull cults (Apis, Mnevis, Buchis), Serapis, the Aten (in a registry holding the whole Amarna family), Montu (in a corpus with kings named 'Montu is satisfied'), Seshat, Wepwawet, Sokar, Khenti-Amentiu, and the birth triad Shai/Renenutet/Meskhenet. 74 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/egyptian-expansion.txt. Hapy of the four sons separated from the pre-existing Hapi of the Nile inundation, which carried 'Hapy' as an alias. Naunet given her own record rather than remaining an alias on Nun. Haroeris and Harpocrates recorded as gods with variants[] noting the form-versus-god disagreement; Harsiese dispositioned EXISTING as the registry's Horus. ONE pre-existing record modified: egyptian_ra gains the reciprocal enemy edge to Apep, added to its own transcript. 4 CROSS-TRADITION SAME FIGURE rows (Mandulis, Anat, Astarte, Reshep) defer Egypt's Levantine imports to a later coherent pass. 12 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL, not DONE: 4 BLOCKED rows plus the Levantine imports, the Nubian/Meroitic gods, the mythology-less nome gods and the magical-papyri deities remain. See audits/lane-2/egyptian-census.tsv and egyptian-audit.md.

First Canaanite/Ugaritic pass, with Phoenician. Canaanite 19 -> 42, Phoenician 7 -> 17. A 56-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 5 hits and 51 absences. Ugarit's three narrative poems were in the registry as principals without casts: absent were Athtar (whose feet do not reach Baal's footstool -- the corpus held the South Arabian and Aksumite gods of that theonym and not the Ugaritic one), all three of Baal's daughters, both his messengers, Athirat's messenger, Lotan (the corpus held yahwism_leviathan and not the Ugaritic serpent the Hebrew text quotes), Tunnanu, Shahar and Shalim, the entire human cast of the Kirta epic including Shataqat whom El makes when the assembly will not answer, and Yatpan who kills Aqhat in a registry holding Aqhat and Paghat. 33 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/canaanite-expansion.txt. TWO pre-existing records modified: canaanite_baal gains enemy->canaanite_lotan and canaanite_anat gains enemy->canaanite_tunnanu, both in their own transcript, because enemy is symmetric and the kill is each monster's defining fact. Philo of Byblos's cosmogony cast (Elioun, Berouth, Baetylos, Taautos, Chousor, Sydyk, Misor) is admitted with the source's euhemerism stated on every record; Sanchuniathon himself REJECTED as a claimed transmitter rather than a figure. 6 REJECT are mostly transparent epithets (Nahar, Baal Zaphon, Athtart-shem-Baal).
